verdict.rationale: The Composio CLI documents authentication (`composio login --agent`) and installing native plugins into coding agents (`composio setup --target auto`), plus generic tool execution/debugging (composio-docs-10,11,19,24,25). However, building or 'staging' an MCP server and pushing it is shown only via the Python SDK (`composio.mcp.create(...)`) rather than the CLI itself, so the CLI-driven build-and-push half of the workflow is unevidenced. missing for 10: CLI commands to stage/build a server, CLI commands to push/deploy a server, independent confirmation of the full CLI workflow end-to-end.
